BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What is crack cocaine? ASSISTANT:

Crack cocaine is a form of cocaine that is processed and sold in a powder form. It is inexpensive, highly addictive, and can cause harm to the user. Crack cocaine is typically smoked and produces an immediate high, which is why it is so addictive. It can also lead to serious health problems, including respiratory issues and heart problems.
